item.description:

item.title: Mcp 1 Why You Need an Mcp Gateway
item.description:
Why every enterprise rolling out MCP needs a gateway — and how to build one on Entra ID

Part 1 of three. A walk-through of an open, MIT-licensed reference gateway I built on FastMCP, OPA and Microsoft Entra ID.

Part 1 of 3 — the control point. Part 2: Three layers of policy · Part 3: What it takes to run one

What this series is for

The gateway this series describes is a teaching artifact. It runs, it is tested, and every claim below is something you can go and read in the repo — but it exists to show you what an MCP gateway has to do, not to be dropped into your cluster on Monday.

item.title: Audit Log Is the Product
item.description: In a regulated environment, the audit trail has the same status as the feature. The durable execution engine you pick settles where your evidence commits — before you write a line of compliance code.
